Enquiries with budget, replies and follow-ups
One row per enquiry: contact, trip type, destination, budget, source and advisor; reply and quote timing, follow-up checks, budget per person and the value of a won trip fill in by themselves.
Quotes with margin, expiry and chase check
One row per quote sent: price, supplier net, service fee and expected commission; the margin, margin on net, days to expiry and who to chase fill in by themselves.
Quote lines by supplier with mark-up and margin
One row per component of a quote: supplier category, supplier, nights, net and client price; the mark-up on net, the line margin and the share of the quote fill in by themselves.
Discovery calls with outcome and days to quote
One row per first call with a prospect: enquiry, minutes, advisor and outcome; the contact, phone, days until the quote and the next-step check fill in by themselves.
Trip briefs with budget per person per night
One row per trip brief: travellers, nights, travel window, budget, must-haves, avoid list and pace; the contact, travel window length and budget per person per night fill in by themselves.
Clients with trips, sales and repeat flag
One row per client: kind, home airport, interest, stage and who referred them; the number of trips, total sales and the repeat-client flag fill in by themselves.
Trips with price, commission and deposit check
One row per trip: client, type, dates, advisor, price, supplier net, expected commission and service fee; the commission share, price per person, days to book and deposit check fill in by themselves.
Suppliers with commission rate and quoted value
One row per supplier: category, commission rate, deposit and final payment terms, who collects the money and days until commission is paid; the lines quoted and their value fill in by themselves.
Service fee schedule with repeat-client waivers
One row per paid service: unit, fee and whether it is waived for a repeat client; the fee for a repeat client, its share of the average trip and the review check fill in by themselves.
Share of the average trip price
Standard trip packages with price per night
Twelve standard offers to show a client who has a budget but no plan: type, nights, travellers and from price; the price per night and per person fill in by themselves.
Destination prices by season for a quick budget check
Eight popular destinations in peak, shoulder and low season: hotel night, daily spend and air fare per person; the trip cost per person for 7 nights fills in by itself.
Lost enquiries with reason and price gap
One row per enquiry that did not book: reason, estimated price gap, who won and what would have saved it; the contact, budget and gap share fill in by themselves.
Follow-up log of every touch with the next one planned
One row per call, message or visit after an enquiry or a quote: channel, outcome and the next touch date; the contact, phone, days since the touch and the next-touch check fill in by themselves.
Referral partners with enquiries, bookings and value
One row per partner who sends clients: kind, contact and thank-you date; the enquiries sent, trips booked, value won, conversion and the thank-you check fill in by themselves.
Marketing results by month and source
One row per source and month: spend, leads, enquiries, bookings and revenue; the cost per enquiry and the cost per booking fill in by themselves.
Quote terms library of standard clauses
Twelve standard clauses to paste under a quote: validity, price changes, deposit, final payment, cancellation, entry documents and insurance advice; the review check fills in by itself.
Advisor capacity by week with free hours
One row per advisor and week: hours available for clients and hours committed to planning; the free hours, the week status and whether a new trip fits fill in by themselves.
Twelve months of enquiries, quotes and bookings counted over every year of history, so the busy months show; the quote-to-booking rate and the month type fill in by themselves.
Team with hours, advisor share and open work
The owner advisor, four advisors and seven freelance specialists with hours a week and advisor share of the agency commission; the open quotes and the sales of each advisor fill in by themselves.
Pipeline by month with win rate
One row per month for the last 14 months; enquiries, quotes, wins, losses, sales won and the win rate all count themselves from Enquiries and Quotes.

Hello {contact}, thank you for your enquiry about {destination}. Can we talk on {follow_up_date}? Please tell me a time that suits you.
Client: your discovery call is confirmed
Hello {contact}, your discovery call with {advisor} is confirmed for {date}, about {minutes} minutes. Please tell us if the time changes.
Client: send your dates and names
Hello {contact}, to plan your trip please send your travel dates and the names of all {travellers} travellers as they appear on their travel documents.
Client: your trip brief is ready
Hello {contact}, your trip brief is ready: {travellers} travellers, {nights} nights, a budget of {budget}. Please check it and tell us what to change.
Hello {client}, your quote for {destination} is ready: {total_quote} for {travellers} travellers. Shall we go through it together?
Client: your quote is valid until
Hello {client}, your quote for {destination} is valid until {valid_until}. After that date prices may change. Please tell us if you need more time.
Hello {client}, a gentle reminder about your {destination} quote sent on {date_sent}. Do you have questions, or would a call help?
Client: three options for your budget
Hello {contact}, for your budget of {budget} we can offer three options: about {opt_low}, {budget} or {opt_high} for the whole trip. Which feels closest?
Client: the price explained line by line
Hello {client}, I will send your {destination} quote line by line. The total is {total_quote}, which is {per_person} per person. Our service fee of {service_fee} is its own line.
Client: your deposit secures the price
Hello {client}, your deposit secures the price of your {destination} trip. It is due on {deposit_due}. Please tell us when it is sent.
Hello {client}, your deposit arrived on {deposit_paid_on}. Thank you. Your {destination} trip is secured.
Hello {client}, thank you for booking {destination}. Next we will send your payment dates, a travel document check and your itinerary. Your trip number is {trip_id}.
Client: prices may change after expiry
Hello {client}, prices for {destination} may change after {valid_until}. Please tell us by then if you want to book at {total_quote}.
Hello {contact}, thank you for considering us. We are sorry we could not match your budget for your {trip_type} trip. We would be glad to help in the future.
Client: thank you for the referral
Hello {name}, thank you for recommending us to a friend. It means a great deal to the whole team.
Client: your quote change is attached
Hello {client}, your quote change is attached. The total is now {total_quote} and it is valid until {valid_until}. Please check it and tell us.
Client: a question about your dates
Hello {contact}, a quick question about your dates: can you travel any time between {window_start} and {window_end}?
Partner: we booked a trip you sent
Hello {contact}, we booked a trip you sent, thank you. You have sent {leads} enquiries and {bookings} became trips so far. A thank-you is on its way.
Partner: a new enquiry that may suit you
Hello {contact}, we have a new enquiry that may suit you or your clients. Please call us if you would like to hear more.
Hello, the quote for {client} expires on {valid_until}. Total {total_quote}. Chase check: {chase_flag}. Please decide whether to ask for an extension.
Owner: enquiry above the usual budget
Hello, the enquiry from {contact} is above the usual budget: {budget} for {travellers} travellers ({trip_type}, {destination}). Please join the first call.
Owner: a quote needs your approval
Hello, the quote for {client} needs your approval: total {total_quote}, margin {margin}. Margin check: {margin_flag}.
Owner: the weekly sales summary is ready
Hello, the sales summary is ready. In {month}: {enquiries} enquiries, {quotes} quotes, {won} won, sales won {sales_won}.
Owner: the margin is below the target
Hello, the margin on the {destination} quote for {client} is {margin_net} of the net price, below the target. Total {total_quote}. Please review the fee.
Advisor: new enquiry assigned to you
Hello, a new enquiry is assigned to you: {contact}, {trip_type}, {destination}, budget {budget}, {travellers} travellers. Please reply within a day.
Advisor: trip booked, start the handover
Hello, trip {trip_id} for {client} to {destination} is booked. Please start the handover and check the deposit date, {deposit_due}.
Hello {advisor}, your capacity is full in the week of {week}: {free_hours} free hours. Please do not take new trips in that week without asking the owner.
Hello {name}, are you available to draw up an itinerary for a new trip? Please tell us your rate and the days you can offer.
Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

Dear {col:quotes.client}, thank you for the chance to plan your {col:quotes.trip_type} trip to {col:quotes.destination} for {col:quotes.travellers} travellers. This page sets out our proposal and the price.

Total price: {col:quotes.total_quote}, which is {col:quotes.per_person} per person. Our service fee of {col:quotes.service_fee} is included and shown as its own line. Prices are before any tax. The components of the trip add up to {col:quotes.lines_total}.
This proposal is valid until {col:quotes.valid_until}. After that date prices and availability may change. To accept it, sign below and pay the deposit we confirm with you.

Quote comparison of {set:company} for {col:enquiries.contact}, dated {today}. Enquiry {col:enquiries.enquiry_id}: {col:enquiries.trip_type} to {col:enquiries.destination}, {col:enquiries.travellers} travellers.
Your budget: {col:enquiries.budget}, which is {col:enquiries.budget_pp} per person. Our quote: {col:enquiries.quote_total}. The quote less your budget: {col:enquiries.quote_gap}.
